description: I have had a great time canvassing the six counties of House District 110. As this campaign season draws to a close, I am excited to see what the election results will be. I know that I gave my all to this campaign with integrity and honor. I know that I will give my all to the District if I win.

title: Final Weeks — Vote Irizarry
